name: Software Engineering
description: Individual-contributor software engineering roles — backend, frontend, platform, infrastructure and reliability.
notes: Entries wrapped in slashes are regexes; plain entries are phrases matched on whole words.
Regexes are used only where one rule needs to cover several spellings.
Nothing here is required — delete any row that doesn't fit how you search.
title: /\bsoftware\s+(engineer|developer)/
/\b(back|front)[\s-]?end\s+(engineer|developer)/
/\bfull[\s-]?stack\s+(engineer|developer)/
/\b(staff|principal|senior|lead)\s+(software\s+)?engineer/
/\bplatform\s+engineer/
/\binfrastructure\s+engineer/
/\bsite\s+reliability\s+engineer|\bSRE\b/
/\bdevops\s+engineer/
/\bsystems\s+engineer/
/\bdistributed\s+systems\s+engineer/
